$schema: camera preset registry — original authoring for CineForge AI; generic cinematography vocabulary; fragments are our own prompt language

camera_moves.name: Static
camera_moves.fragment: locked-off camera, steady composure, no camera movement

camera_moves.name: Zoom In
camera_moves.fragment: slow optical zoom tightening the frame toward the subject

camera_moves.name: Zoom Out
camera_moves.fragment: slow optical zoom widening the frame away from the subject

camera_moves.name: Dolly In
camera_moves.fragment: smooth dolly push-in gliding toward the subject

camera_moves.name: Dolly Out
camera_moves.fragment: smooth dolly pull-back retreating from the subject

camera_moves.name: Orbit Left
camera_moves.fragment: camera arcs left around the subject with a smooth orbital sweep

camera_moves.name: Orbit Right
camera_moves.fragment: camera arcs right around the subject with a smooth orbital sweep

camera_moves.name: Pan Left
camera_moves.fragment: gentle pan to the left, horizon sweeping across frame

camera_moves.name: Pan Right
camera_moves.fragment: gentle pan to the right, horizon sweeping across frame

camera_moves.name: Tilt Up
camera_moves.fragment: camera tilts upward revealing the top of the scene

camera_moves.name: Tilt Down
camera_moves.fragment: camera tilts downward settling on the lower part of the scene

camera_moves.name: Crane Up
camera_moves.fragment: crane rises vertically lifting the viewpoint above the scene

camera_moves.name: Crane Down
camera_moves.fragment: crane descends vertically lowering the viewpoint into the scene

camera_moves.name: Tracking Shot
camera_moves.fragment: side-on tracking shot following the moving subject along its path

camera_moves.name: FPV Drone
camera_moves.fragment: first-person-view drone flight weaving fast through the environment

camera_moves.name: Drone Shot
camera_moves.fragment: aerial drone shot descending and pushing toward the landscape

camera_moves.name: Handheld
camera_moves.fragment: handheld camera with organic, imperfect operator motion

camera_moves.name: POV
camera_moves.fragment: point-of-view shot from the subject's eyes

camera_moves.name: Robot Arm
camera_moves.fragment: precise robotic arm camera move, mechanical sweeping parallax

camera_moves.name: Helicopter Shot
camera_moves.fragment: helicopter aerial circling wide over the terrain

camera_moves.name: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo)
camera_moves.fragment: vertigo dolly-zoom, background compressing while subject stays fixed

camera_moves.name: Push + Slow Motion
camera_moves.fragment: slow-motion dolly push with heightened detail
